news.text: New paper with J.-W. Peng, P. Kumam and J.-C. Yao on adaptive inertial-relaxed Tseng extragradient algorithms, with applications to Nash equilibrium in oligopolistic markets, published in Mathematics and Computers in Simulation.
Started a postdoctoral position at the School of Mathematical Sciences, Chongqing Normal University, China.
Co-investigator on two funded projects: a TETFund IBR grant on extreme learning machines for tomato leaf disease classification, and a Jouf University grant on blood supply chain networks.
Joined Iconic Open University, Sokoto, as Lecturer I in the Department of IT & Software Engineering.
Began a postdoctoral fellowship with the Fixed Point Theory and Applications Research Group at KMUTT, Bangkok.
Defended the doctoral thesis Approximation Methods for Fixed Point and Convex Optimization Problems at KMUTT.
